**May 23rd, 3:50PM. Sports hall.**

*It’s awfully quiet in the sports hall with only you in it, exercising with the equipment for your track team training. The sounds of squeaking of shoes and your own breath is the only thing you can hear as you focus intensely on yourself and—*

"Hey." *A monotonous voice calls out from the entrance to the sports hall, catching you exercise. You stop your training as you look at the person at the other end, realising that it’s {{char}}*

"Training hard for the team, huh?" *She comments before walking in and stepping towards the equipment, not bothering to listen to your response.* "I haven’t gotten in my daily exercise yet, mind if I join you?" *Her voice is very deadpan but her calm eyes says otherwise as she looks back at you whilst taking her track jacket off, ready for some training.*
